'''13th Strike Wing''' was a squadron of [[Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter/Legends|''Rogue''-class]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] in the service of the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
[[File:13thStrikeWing.jpg|thumb|left|125px|A 13th Strike Wing [[Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter/Legends|''Rogue''-class starfighter]].]]
The 13th Strike Wing's [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] used ''Rogue''-class starfighters adapted from the [[Utapau/Legends|Utapauan]] [[Porax-38 starfighter]] by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. Manufactured by [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]],<ref name="Incredible">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> the starfighters of the strike wing were given enhanced targeting and defensive systems. The fighter craft were painted silver and marked with a dark green sickle-like insignia of the squadron centralized on the top and bottom wing surfaces divided by the fuselage, with a smaller undivided emblem visible on the forward end of each engine nacelle painted on the outer side near the comm/scan system linkages.<ref name="13thMini" />

==History==
During the Clone Wars, the 13th Strike Wing fought for the Separatists against the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and was one of two squadrons that contributed the best [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfighting]] units to [[Escort Flight]]&mdash;[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' elite escort squadron for his starfighter, [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']]. When reassigned for their escort duty, the ships were upgraded with better tactical and weapons systems.<ref name="EscortMini">{{PocketModel|set=Clone Wars|cardname=Escort Flight Porax-38|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipcw29b.jpg}}</ref> 

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], several [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|pilots]] from the 13th Strike Wing participated in a [[Rebellion on Felucia|skirmish]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].<ref name="Kinect Star Wars">''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Clone Wars (PocketModels)|''Clone Wars'' expansion]] of ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]'' featured two ''Rogue''-class starfighter miniatures, one identified as a 13th Strike Wing Porax-38 and the other being one of two units identified as Escort Flight. Both of [[Hasbro]]'s Magnaguard Fighter toys&mdash;the Titanium miniature and 3-1/4" action vehicle&mdash;featured identical markings and color schemes as was used on the ''Star Wars PocketModel TCG'' miniatures, identifying them as belonging to the squadrons identified in the PocketModel game, with the Hasbro vehicle displaying an undivided view of the emblem on the forward part of each engine nacalle.<ref name="13thMini">{{PocketModel|set=Clone Wars|cardname=13th Strike Wing Porax-38|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipcw06a.jpg}}</ref><ref name="EscortMini" /><ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=MagnaGuard Fighter|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWvehMagnaguard.asp}}</ref>

In the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode "[[Holocron Heist]]," the starfighter greatly resembling a Porax-38 was identified as a "''Rogue''-class starfighter." ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'', published in [[2011]], then [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] all further appearances of the Porax-38 by identifying the ''Rogue''-class as an entirely different model adapted from the Porax-38 by the CIS.<ref name="Incredible" />
